featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Daugavpils.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

today.name: A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION
today.description:
# **A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION**
![](https://i.postimg.cc/bNnzfPXr/02b296bb-c3b1-4921-bf72-a0b9761ddb47.png)

GTLEGION VTC invites you to a special Halloween-themed convoy where the road becomes the beginning of a nightmare.

This October, GTLEGION VTC invites drivers to leave the ordinary roads behind and enter a darker world filled with mysterious nights, Halloween atmosphere, glowing pumpkins, foggy roads and the feeling that something may be waiting around the next corner.

Inspired by the atmosphere of classic horror cinema and the nightmare concept of A Nightmare on Elm Street, this convoy combines the spirit of Halloween with the freedom of the open road.

But remember:

 Some nightmares should stay in the night.*




> “One, two, Freddy's coming for you.
> Three, four, better lock your door.
> Five, six, grab your crucifix.
> Seven, eight, gonna stay up late.
> Nine, ten, never sleep again.”


-----

![](https://i.postimg.cc/j5vdy6yP/convoy-route.gif)
### 🛣️ **THE ROUTE**

Our journey will begin in Bern, Switzerland
![](https://i.postimg.cc/X7sgWRw0/Route.png)

**Expect:**

* 
* 🌲 Dark forests and atmospheric roads
* 🌙 Night-time scenery
* 🏔️ Mountain landscapes
* 🌉 Scenic viewpoints
* 🛣️ Interesting and varied roads
* 📸 Multiple opportunities for screenshots and photography
* 🎃 A Halloween atmosphere throughout the journey



-----
### 🎃 **THE HALLOWEEN ATMOSPHERE**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/mgx7TTPB/ae0b475d7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

This is not a traditional Halloween party.

The entire convoy will be built around a darker horror atmosphere.

**Expect:**

* 🎃 Pumpkins
* 🌕 Moonlit roads
* 🌫️ Fog and darkness
* 🦇 Halloween decorations
* 🧤 Nightmare-inspired elements
* 🔪 Horror-style visuals
* 🚛 Specially prepared convoy vehicles
* 🌙 A night-time atmosphere



-----

🎥 **EVENT MEDIA**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/V6Hbp8xR/7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

The convoy will also receive dedicated media coverage.

Our media team will capture the most atmospheric moments of the journey, including:

* 📸 Event photography
* 🎥 Convoy footage
* 📺 Video content
* ▶️ Short clips
* 🌙 Night-time shots
* 🚛 Group formations
* 🎃 Halloween-themed screenshots
* ⭐ Event highlights

Selected moments from the convoy may later be used for GTLEGION media content and event highlights.



-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/NjSfrk3k/8ad7-8db93eb9d09a.png)
-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/4ymZtDJb/convoycontrolstrobe.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/fTVDVB3R/Event-Supervised-By.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/pdqgZsc0/media.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/sXZVfCBn/1d537353-d484-4a38-81c1-3a2f6840dfd3.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/0ygxMXhG/real-ops.gif)
[![](https://i.postimg.cc/VLdxk1F3/real_ops_banner_1920x550_watermarked.png)](https://discord.gg/realops)

upcoming.name: EXPORT OF NORDIC SALMONS TO THE EUROPE!
upcoming.description:
## EXPORT OF NORDIC SALMONS TO THE EUROPE! 🐟
- Export severských lososů do srdce Evropy!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/WNPDcQ8.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for the Salmon Fillet.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Bergen.
*  **19:00**  - Departure from Bergen to Oslo Highway.
*  **19:15**- Passage trough wonderful Bergen Tunnels.
*  **19:25** - Passage around the city of Oslo.
*  **19:50** - Arrival to the pause near Helsingborg.
*  **20:00** - Departure from the pause near Helsingborg.
*  **20:15** - Crossing over The Øresund Bridge - Denmark.
*  **20:25** - Denmark // Germany border.
*  **20:35** - Passage around the city of Hamburg.
*  **21:00** - Arrival to the city of Duisburg and final photo.


![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/EODxGdP.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Bergen, Industrial Area - Duisburg, Container Port.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL SLOTS - BERGEN INDUSTRIAL ZONE:

![](https://i.imgur.com/aSOxC7M.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)


[![](https://i.imgur.com/c0lnezn.png)](https://trucksbook.eu/company/176895)

尽管团队在成立初期经历了一些磨合与挑战，但凭借坚定的信念与不断的努力，大家逐渐融合为一个紧密团结的整体。在每一次大型活动中，我们都会认真总结经验、查找不足，并共同探讨优化方案，从而持续提升活动的流畅度与参与体验。

多支车队均为团队的创始成员，彼此之间没有高低之分，始终保持着平等沟通、协同决策的良好氛围，共创团队美好未来。

upcoming.rule:
📜 **ETS2 / TRUCKERSMP CONVOY RULES** 📜

### Article 1 – General Rules

- All participants must follow the official TruckersMP rules as well as the instructions given by the convoy organizers.
- Respect, courtesy and fair play are mandatory towards all participants.
- Any intentional disruption of the convoy may result in immediate removal.

### Article 2 – Convoy Preparation

- Participants must be present at the departure point at least 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time.
- Each driver must park in the position assigned by the organizers.
- Departure may only take place following instructions from the Leader or Convoy Control.
- Staff-exclusive player tags must never be used by participants.

### Article 3 – Driving Behaviour

- Overtaking other participants is strictly prohibited unless authorized by the staff.
- Each driver must maintain a safe distance from the vehicle in front.
- Sudden and unnecessary braking is prohibited.
- Participants must maintain their assigned position within the convoy.
- The speed limits set by the Leader must be respected.
- Dangerous driving, intentional collisions or trolling will result in disciplinary action.

### Article 4 – Communication

- Voice communications must remain clear and related to the convoy.
- Insults, provocations and discriminatory remarks are prohibited.
- Only the Leader and moderation team may give traffic and convoy instructions.
- Off-topic discussions should be kept to a minimum during the journey.
